prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin for sign_in and reorder changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Evidence is still thin for finish and new_screen changes, as only one test has been completed so far.
Predictions have consistently been too high compared to measured results.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- finish, new_screen: -5.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- sign_in, reorder: +3.8% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.0%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 18.6%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Carousel pick friend gallery: Redesign the pet selection view into an interactive hero carousel layout with vibrant companion previews. (why: Adoption has a steep drop-off at 60.9% and high median time (89s), indicating users struggle to pick a pet efficiently.)
1: [choose_path, new_screen] Interactive path teaser preview screen: Add a new animated preview screen right after the story intro demonstrating custom vs instant pets. (why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s, showing users get stuck deciding between preset pets and photo upload.)
2: [home, wait_info] Generation progress estimate and tips: Show estimated waiting time and pet tips carousel on the waiting screen while desktop pet assets generate. (why: The home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s with 81.3% conversion, leaving users wondering if the app stalled.)
3: [sign_in, redesign] Centered sign-in layout with account recovery callout: Redesign the sign-in screen to a focused centered layout emphasizing cloud pet saving and restore options. (why: 8 support emails complained about pets missing after signing in again, showing confusion around cloud account binding.)
4: [finish, redesign] Stage view desktop landing intro: Rebuild the final home intro into a stage layout showing the pet arriving directly on the user's desktop taskbar. (why: Finish completion drops to 64.8% with 3 support emails reporting pets not visible on desktop after setup.)
5: [adoption, hint] Photo quality guidance checklist hint: Display explicit photo quality guidelines and sample images on the photo upload screen. (why: Support received 3 reports of custom pet creation failing or looking wrong due to poor photo uploads.)
6: [choose_path, copy] Simplified story intro headline: Shorten and clarify the initial story screen headline to get users into pet selection faster. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s, indicating slow engagement on the initial intro screens.)
7: [home, notification] System tray ready notification alert: Enable native desktop notification alert when pet asset generation finishes in the background. (why: Waiting takes 201s median / 2336s mean, causing users to minimize or abandon the window while waiting.)
8: [finish, incentive] First interaction welcome badge bonus: Display a decorative adoption certificate badge on the final welcome screen to celebrate completing setup. (why: Overall onboarding completion is low at 18.6%, requiring stronger completion momentum at the final step.)
